lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: WARDEN-5 was designed to handle exactly this scenario. A mobile threat. An unpredictable variable.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: It has neutralized forty-seven such variables before you. I see no reason for forty-eight to be different.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: Its targeting array locks onto you directly -- use a portal to break its line of sight!

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: ECHO. You were always better at helping people die efficiently.
